overview.commentary: The portfolio returned 61.81% annualised against 18.91% volatility (Sharpe 2.40) — excellent risk-adjusted performance at a moderate risk level. BAC carries the largest weight at 35.0%; AMD dominates risk contribution at 48.1%. On a typical bad day expect losses near 1.90% (95% VaR), with the worst 5% averaging 2.49% (CVaR) and peak-to-trough drawdown over the period of -10.97%. Action: trim or hedge AMD — it is the single biggest driver of portfolio risk.
